steps.title: Szamorodni
steps.body: Szamorodni, a Polish word meaning as it comes, is made from whole bunches with some botrytised berries, not separated. It can be édes, sweet, or száraz, dry. Dry Szamorodni ages under a film of yeast, like Sherry's flor, in barrels not completely filled, giving nutty, oxidative notes. Sweet Szamorodni is lighter than Aszú.
steps.highlight: As it comes: sweet or dry

steps.title: Eszencia
steps.body: Eszencia, or Esszencia, is the free-run juice that drips from aszú berries under their own weight, before soaking. It's extraordinarily sweet, often 450 to 800 g/l of sugar, and ferments for years, reaching only 3 to 5% alcohol. Tiny quantities are made. It's traditionally served by the spoon and was believed to have healing powers.

steps.prompt: Match each wine to its making.
steps.explanation: Tokaj makes several wines from one harvest.

steps.title: Dry Furmint
steps.body: Since the 2000s, Tokaj has made more dry wine, mainly from Furmint, from healthy grapes. It's mineral, smoky, with quince and citrus, and can be rich and textured, often compared with white Burgundy. Single-vineyard dry Furmint is now a major part of Tokaj's identity, especially as botrytis doesn't come every year.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Szamorodni uses whole bunches, sweet or dry
Eszencia is free-run juice, extraordinarily sweet
Dry Furmint is Tokaj's modern style
